problem:
Given that 

$$
\frac{x+4}{({x}^{2}+4)x}=\frac{-x+B}{{x}^{2}+4}+\frac{1}{x},
$$

what is the value of $B?$

examples.knowledge_point: Computing Coefficients in a Partial Fractions Decomposition
examples.problem:
Given that 

$$
\dfrac{7 x^2 - 2x - 13 }{(x^2+1)(x+1) } = \dfrac{9x+B}{ x^2 +1} - \dfrac{2}{x+1} ,
$$

what is the value of $B?$
examples.worked_solution:
Multiplying both sides of the given equality by $(x^2+1)(x+1)$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}7{x}^{2}-2x-13 & =(9x+B)(x+1)-2({x}^{2}+1).\end{aligned}
$$

Letting $x=0$  gives

$$
\begin{aligned}7(0)^{2}-2(0)-13 & =(9\cdot (0)+B)(0+1)-2((0)^{2}+1) \\ -13 & =B-2 \\ B & =-11.\end{aligned}
$$
